title: PG-14.1 Federation demonstrators and benchmark (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP14 in memev: Federation demonstrators and benchmark. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP14.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP03-02, WP08-04, WP09-03, WP10-03, WP12-03, WP13-04. Depends on contracts: SO-2.04, SO-2.05, SO-2.06, PG-12.1. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.04 and SO-2.05: WP14-04 names the demonstrators and depends on these design records for the organisational-intelligence demonstrator; it defines no organisational-knowledge model and builds no discovery logic. Boundary with SO-2.06: the acceptance tests of the organisational-intelligence demonstrator are defined there, not in WP14-04. Pending owner decision (which layer to build against): the unsigned Scope One fold SO-F-01 to SO-F-13 (cited by id only) overlaps this spec at SO-F-13. Which layer is built against is open and is the owner's call. This spec is not signed until it is decided, and nothing is dropped on the strength of the unsigned fold. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
